```artifact
@startuml

actor Patient
actor Doctor
actor Chemist
actor Admin
participant "Patient History File" as PHF
participant "Patient Appointment File" as PAF
participant "Consultation Request File" as CRF
participant "Machine Learning Algorithm" as MLA
participant "Prescription File" as PF

== TC-001: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Offline) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms, Reports, Mode=Offline)
CRF -> MLA: New Consultation Request
MLA -> CRF: Prioritize Request (Critical/Medium/Low)
CRF -> Doctor: Notify New Consultation Request

== TC-002: Patient creates a Consultation Request (Appointment) ==
Patient -> CRF: Create Consultation Request (Symptoms, Reports, Mode=Appointment, Date=Next Day)
alt Date is Next Day
    CRF -> PAF: Create Appointment Entry
else Date is not Next Day
    CRF -> CRF: Store Request for Batch Processing
end
CRF -> MLA: New Consultation Request
MLA -> CRF: Prioritize Request (Critical/Medium/Low)
CRF -> Doctor: Notify New Consultation Request

== TC-003: Batch Program for Next 5 Days Appointments ==
Admin -> PAF: Run Batch Program
PAF -> PAF: Purge Existing Files
PAF -> CRF: Fetch Consultation Requests for Next 5 Days
loop For each Request
    CRF -> PAF: Create Appointment Entry
end

== TC-004: Machine Learning Algorithm Prioritizes Requests ==
MLA -> CRF: Fetch New Consultation Requests
loop For each Request
    MLA -> MLA: Analyze Symptoms and Reports
    MLA -> CRF: Prioritize Request (Critical/Medium/Low)
end

== TC-005: Doctor Provides Diagnosis and Prescribes Medicines ==
Doctor -> CRF: Fetch Prioritized Consultation Requests
Doctor -> CRF: Provide Diagnosis and Prescribe Medicines
CRF -> PF: Create Prescription Entry
PF -> Chemist: Notify New Prescription

== TC-006: Chemist Updates Prescription Status ==
Chemist -> PF: Fetch Open Prescriptions
Chemist -> PF: Update Prescription Status
PF -> Patient: Notify Prescription Status Update

@enduml
```
